metadata.question: Was there more smoke on January 1, 2020 in the coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia compared to July 24, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about smoke levels in coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia, comparing January 1, 2020 vs July 24, 2019. For smoke detection, I should use aerosol optical depth (AOD) data from MODIS as it's a good proxy for smoke/particulate matter. The MODIS Terra/Aqua combined product (MCD19A2) provides AOD at 1km resolution. Strategy: 1. Define coastal regions of Victoria and NSW using a polygon 2. Use MCD19A2 product for AOD data 3. Get images for both specific dates 4. Calculate mean AOD values for comparison 5. Handle potential data issues (no images, no valid pixels, etc.) I need to: - Check if images exist for both dates - Check if there are valid pixels after masking - Compare the AOD values to determine if there was more smoke ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const coastalRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[140.0, -39.0], [155.0, -39.0], [155.0, -28.0], [140.0, -28.0], [140.0, -39.0]] ]); const date1 = '2019-07-24'; const date2 = '2020-01-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MCD19A2 for Aerosol Optical Depth (smoke proxy) const modisAOD = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterBounds(coastalRegion) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); const img1 = modisAOD.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const img2 = modisAOD.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).first(); // Check if images exist const img1Exists = img1 ? true : false; const img2Exists = img2 ? true : false; if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { console.log(`2019-07-24 Image: ${img1Exists ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`); console.log(`2020-01-01 Image: ${img2Exists ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean AOD values const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: coastalRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: coastalRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('Optical_Depth_047_mean'); const count1 = stats1.get('Optical_Depth_047_count'); const mean2 = stats2.get('Optical_Depth_047_mean'); const count2 = stats2.get('Optical_Depth_047_count'); // Get values const mean1Val = mean1.getInfo(); const count1Val = count1.getInfo(); const mean2Val = mean2.getInfo(); const count2Val = count2.getInfo(); console.log(`2019-07-24: AOD=${mean1Val?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count1Val}`); console.log(`2020-01-01: AOD=${mean2Val?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2Val}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count1Val === 0 || count2Val === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1Val === null || mean2Val === null || isNaN(mean1Val) || isNaN(mean2Val) || mean1Val < 0 || mean2Val < 0 || mean1Val > 5 || mean2Val > 5) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare AOD values (higher AOD = more smoke) if (mean2Val > mean1Val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
